title: ContextPack original save requests and historical observations v1
description: Complete historical save receipt response, with anchors for verified identity metadata, original requests and local observation files. A recorded receipt does not check current content or sources; not-observed does not prove save failure.
$comment: Source artifact only; no validator, generator or runtime verification was executed. Register this whole self-contained local resource before resolving anchors. Its ID is an identifier, not a hosted endpoint. Retain the existing save context/original/receipt/file parsers and adapter digest, authority, binding and byte-limit checks. This is not an HTTP schema, a compile success envelope, a CLI stdout wrapper, an MCP wrapper or a browser history backup.

ulid.$comment: Existing isUlid characters and length, without a new first-character restriction.

identifier.$comment: Trace and client text retain whitespace but require a non-whitespace character. Runtime also rejects unpaired surrogates and counts UTF-16 units, not JSON Schema code points.

requestKey.$comment: Unlike client/trace text, the complete original key permits no whitespace anywhere. Runtime also checks UTF-16 length and unpaired surrogates. Preserve exact text; never generate a replacement on recovery.

timestamp.$comment: Runtime requires a valid exact UTC millisecond round-trip and rejects year 0000. Format may be annotation-only. Historical observation and pack timestamps need not be future dates.

ContextPackSaveIdentity.$comment: Complete original identity, not authentication credentials or an authority override. All five fields must match the trusted caller.

ContextPackSaveDraft.$comment: At most 4096 bytes at runtime. Optional draft/compile parameters only; defaults are annotations and normalization remains in parseContextPackCompileParameters. Null is not omission. Does not include CLI key/identity/timeout options or the complete original request.

ContextPackSaveParameters.$comment: Both values are mandatory in an original file and receipt query/echo. No default insertion or replacement is allowed in those structures.

ContextPackSaveContextEnvelope.$comment: Complete 16384-byte save-context success envelope. Runtime binds trace/identity and adapters enforce current expiry and actual permissions. This metadata neither reserves a request key nor proves a save.

gateway_url.$comment: Lexical boundary only, deliberately not an RFC URI assertion. Runtime requires exact packGateway WHATWG normalization, no surrounding whitespace, user/password, nonempty search/hash, and removal of trailing slashes. Includes deployment path. Caller must compare with the actual trusted destination; the server receipt does not echo or authenticate it.

PackSaveBinding.$comment: At most 8192 bytes at runtime. Complete equality is checked by assertPackSaveBinding; structural validity is not permission to submit.

PackSaveOriginal.$comment: Complete 8192-byte CLI/Web original request document. No trace, token, review flag or request hash field. A review flag belongs to the submitting interface, not to this transferable document.

ContextPackSaveReceiptQuery.$comment: Complete 4096-byte historical lookup body and response echo; derived from the original request, without gateway_url. Exact request/echo equality and actual destination binding remain runtime checks. A receipt lookup never submits the save.

ContextPackRecordedSave.$comment: Exactly ten historical scalar fields. Runtime requires created_at < expires_at, used_tokens <= budget_tokens, budget equality with original parameters and lifetime <= original ttl_seconds. Six directory metadata fields are also checked within 2048 bytes. Hash syntax does not check content; expired packs may have valid historical receipts.

ContextPackSaveReceiptSourceRef.$comment: The sole recorded-result source must match receipt.pack_id/version; this is not a full content/source-validity assertion.

ContextPackSaveReceiptEnvelope.$comment: Complete 16384-byte success envelope. Recorded requires one matching source; not-observed requires no source or receipt. Runtime compares the full original echo and trace, cross-checks all metadata and authenticates the reader. Not-observed is a successful observation, not proof of failure or permission to resend. No outer revision, ETag or server_cursor.

ContextPackSaveReceiptDocument.$comment: Complete local 28672-byte document. Runtime derives the receipt query from original and compares it to receipt.data.original. observed_at is local query completion time, not a server signature or a new save time; no ordering relative to server timestamps is asserted.

ContextPackSaveReceiptFile.$comment: Complete 32768-byte CLI/Web file. Adapters must recompute SHA-256 of UTF-8 contextPackSaveReceiptDocumentJson(document) and compare the unprefixed lowercase digest. This covers the canonical parsed document, not raw file bytes or the outer file. A digest is not a signature, authority or current content check. No CLI path/local-state/output wrapper is stored here.
